on_image_text: I am always there for you
in your good and bad times ..
concept: The promise begins with one clean private gesture, then gets proved through ordinary care across three rooms: before the day, during the laugh, and after the hard moment.
why_it_wins: Preserves the user's source idea and exact three-line structure.
Turns a generic hand promise into Aachu/Zuv behavior instead of forcing a hand gimmick into every frame.
Gives each post a distinct emotional job while keeping one continuous ritual.
Avoids copying the competitor's anime look or stacked-hand collage.
Keeps scenes stageable for watercolor-and-ink identity-safe generation later.
risks: Post 1 text can feel generic if the ritual and body language are not specific enough.
Post 3 must stay tender and grounded, not misery-romance.
Image prompts must prevent hand anatomy issues and preserve readable faces.
Do not force pinky-linking into Post 2 or Post 3; those posts should prove the promise through normal hands and body language.

selected_three_post_direction.scene: Morning kitchen/doorway. Aachu and Zuv are half-ready for the day; one has a mug, one has a phone or keys. They make one clean, readable promise gesture in the little gap between them, with hands relaxed and anatomy simple.

selected_three_post_direction.text: I am always there for you
selected_three_post_direction.scene: Casual good-time floor meal. They sit on the floor sharing from one plate, laughing mid-bite. Zuv steadies the plate or slides the last bite toward Aachu while she laughs; hands are natural, separate, and doing care instead of staying linked.

selected_three_post_direction.text: in your good and bad times ..
selected_three_post_direction.scene: Quiet hard evening on sofa or bed edge. They sit close but not face-crowded, tired and wordless. One hand rests open near the other on the cushion, close enough to show presence without a forced pose; a small tissue or medicine strip and one bright object from earlier show both bad and good without melodrama.
